input:
the document upload system keeps assigning the wrong category — say, putting repair quotes under correspondence — which leads to incorrect file type issues.
The document upload system incorrectly categorizes files, such as placing repair quotes under correspondence, which causes file type errors.

can we get policyholder comms automated too? It’s another manual task.
The customer wants to automate policyholder communications because it is currently a manual task.

I’m trying to figure out why my latest batch of claims documents didn’t auto-assign to the right supplier tasks.
The user is experiencing an issue where uploaded claim documents are not automatically assigned to the correct supplier tasks.

We’ve got claims stuck because the reserve change needs approval, and with the approver away and no delegate, the approval waiting list just grows — it’s not sustainable.
The platform lacks a delegate approval feature, causing claims to stall when the primary approver is unavailable.

Right now it’s a mix of spreadsheets and email threads — not ideal when we need to assign tasks or generate letters for policyholders.
The customer is currently relying on disconnected spreadsheets and emails to manage tasks and generate policyholder letters, indicating a lack of integrated workflow features in their current process.

we need better oversight on reserves and supplier performance.
The customer requires improved visibility and control over financial reserves and supplier performance metrics.

we’re getting blocked trying to log into Keelwater again this morning. It’s showing ‘down’
The customer is unable to log into the Keelwater platform, which displays a 'down' status message.

I was wondering if there’s a way to use keyboard shortcuts in claim notes to speed up data entry — it’d save us a lot of time during busy periods.
The customer wants to use keyboard shortcuts in claim notes to speed up data entry.

we’re seeing a mismatch between what’s shown on the MI dashboard and the figures we get when exporting CSVs
The data displayed on the MI dashboard does not match the data in exported CSV files, causing confusion for finance teams.

our finance team noticed the export figures mismatch with what’s shown in the dashboard... they can’t trust which numbers to use for month-end reporting.
The data exported from the platform does not match the totals displayed on the dashboard, creating uncertainty for financial reporting.

we’re trying to submit a high-value specie claim but hit a snag with document uploads.
The user is unable to upload documents when submitting a high-value specie claim.

when a handler tries to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it sits waiting for one specific approver who’s out of office and has no delegate assigned, so nothing moves.
The system blocks reserve adjustments when the designated approver is unavailable and lacks a delegate, causing delays.

I’m under the impression I’m assigned the right role, but maybe something’s misconfigured on our end.
The user suspects a configuration error is preventing them from having the correct role permissions.
